method: Actual view_image inspection of lossless contacts, 3 model rows x hero/front/rear/top columns, 600x540 image thumbnail per cell from native 1000x900 PNG. Original or enlarged details inspected where recorded. Per-image SHA and original source fingerprint retained; inspection is a visual screen, not a certified defect bound or proof of baseline appearance equivalence. Current images can reuse evidence only if image SHA matches.
